conflicts.text: One source says that around 1900 the only mixed stone-and-wood house at Costa da Caparica was a tavern, but the editor disputes this, citing masonry buildings by 1859.

Accounts of the early huts differ: Ílhavo settlers' traditional dwelling is a plank-walled palheiro, yet 18th/19th-century accounts mention only straw huts, and the author suggests they copied Algarvian huts, though plank houses may have existed early.
